versions.name: Extra Icon Locks
versions.description: Locks now come in many colors!

about:
# <cy>Extra Icon Locks</c>

Small mod that adds more locks based on where you'd unlock icons, such as:

- Extra locks from awards of secret and special chests.
- Shop Items having the removed sprite of the bag.
- More to come...

---

### Issues

- The locks won't show up if [Colorful Icons's Hide Locks](https://geode-sdk.org/mods/ninkaz.colorful-icons) setting is enabled.
